objects.description: [APT38](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0082) has named malicious payloads as benign-looking executables to blend in the environment including Run keys, npm packages, and JavaScript utilities often using names mirroring Apple, Windows, or other native system files.(Citation: Microsoft Axios Compromise APR 2026)(Citation: MIcrosoft Mastra npm Compromise JUN 2026)(Citation: Microsoft Sapphire Sleet APR 2026)
